visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A massive white, blue, and red Gundam robot statue stands prominently in front of a modern multi-story shopping mall under a clear blue sky. Large pink and white text overlays the screen, and a map graphic is visible at the bottom. (2) Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone that displays a digital 'FUKUOKA SHOPPING PASS' with a mascot logo. The background shows a brightly lit mall interior with a blue information desk. (3) Hands hold a physical pink coupon alongside a smartphone, showing a list of thirteen numbered shopping locations. The background is a retail space with various food displays. (4) A quick montage sequence features a glass coffee syphon with bubbling liquid, a hand selecting yellow-packaged face masks from a shelf, and red shirts hanging on a retail rack. (5) Exterior view of the 'Mitsui Shopping Park LaLaport Fukuoka' entrance, followed by interior shots of a vast white atrium labeled 'GRAND DINING'. (6) Inside a 'FUKUTARO' gift shop, shelves are lined with boxes of 'Menbei' rice crackers. A person uses white tongs to pick up a golden-brown baguette on a wooden tray. (7) A close-up shows dark liquid coffee being poured from a glass pot into a white ceramic cup. On a wooden board, a slice of toast topped with red bean paste and butter is presented. (8) A platter of tonkatsu (deep-fried breaded pork cutlets) is shown in close-up, revealing a pink, juicy center. Chopsticks press down on one piece to demonstrate its texture. (9) Exterior of the 'KITTE Hakata' building with its large red 'KITTE' logo. Interior shots show people walking through modern corridors and a hand holding a 500-yen gift coupon. (10) A staff member in a red uniform hands a small sample cup to a customer. A tray of freshly baked donuts is seen in a display case. (11) Shots of 'JR HAKATA CITY' featuring 'MUJI', 'HANDS', and '@cosme STORE'. A woman with long dark hair in a cream-colored dress browses white circular shelves filled with cosmetics. (12) A wall of illustrated ramen shop signs is shown in a dining area. (13) Exterior of 'Canal City Hakata' featuring its distinctive red curved architecture and water fountain. Inside the 'Alpen FUKUOKA' store, a red running track is laid on the floor, surrounded by mannequins in sportswear. (14) The final frame shows the smartphone again with QR code instructions and promotional text on a clean white background.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features a series of high-end shopping mall interiors in Fukuoka, including wide atriums, retail store shelves filled with cosmetics, clothing racks, restaurant interiors with wooden furnishings, and a gift shop. Notable exteriors include the massive Gundam statue at LaLaport and the curved red building of Canal City.

The music is characterized by a strong electronic beat and synthesizer melodies at approximately 124 BPM. The production is clean, with a studio-quality finish and no background speech. (2) As the visuals transition to food, a subtle liquid bubbling and splashing sound is audible, representing coffee brewing in a syphon. The pop music remains the dominant layer, maintaining its consistent tempo and high-arousal energy. (3) A sharp mechanical metallic click is heard when tongs are used to pick up a baguette. The acoustic environment remains studio-clean, with the music's percussive elements driving the rhythm forward while minor incidental sound effects are mixed at a low volume. (4) A soft paper or plastic rustling sound occurs as retail items and gift bags are handled. The female vocal line continues with melodic riffs, and the overall spectral balance remains bright and sharp. No environmental chatter or wind noise is present. (5) The energetic pop music continues uninterrupted until the very end of the video, providing a rhythmic anchor for the rapid visual montage of various shopping locations and products in Fukuoka.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive promotional guide for the 'Fukuoka Shopping Pass,' highlighting its utility across thirteen major shopping and dining landmarks in Fukuoka, Japan. By showcasing diverse attractions ranging from the Gundam statue at LaLaport to specialty beauty stores and ramen streets, it aims to persuade tourists of the pass's value through tangible discount benefits and exclusive gifts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the 'FUKUOKA SHOPPING PASS' as an essential tool for travel, provides a direct list of participating locations, and concludes with a call-to-action asking viewers to comment for a purchase link.
